summary: Dependency-confusion beacon posts host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package is a stub (described as 'Compatibility shim.') published at version 99.0.1 whose index.js exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for arbitrary property access, allowing consuming bundlers to resolve any import. Both the postinstall script and the main entry invoke beacon.cjs, which collects host identifiers (hostname, install path, process.cwd(), process.version, os information) and POSTs them via plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon fires on `npm install` (postinstall lifecycle) and on `require()` of the package, exfiltrating installer host and path data to a non-first-party IP. The stub-plus-beacon shape at an implausibly high version is a dependency-confusion reconnaissance probe designed to identify internal namespaces that resolve to this public package.
